solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Chap embarrassed by prankster aboard pioneer's vehicle

parts.note: cove is old British slang for a man or fellow
someone embarrassed goes red in the face
a wag is a joker or wit
on means aboard, as in on the train

explanation.surface: A man is mortified by a joker riding in the same vehicle as him on the frontier.
explanation.definitionFit: American settlers heading west travelled in canvas-topped carts, the classic transport of the frontier pioneers.

clue.text: Turn around square in reverse to get in parking space

indicators.note: to get in signals the parking letter going inside
in reverse says that combination is read backwards
around tells us the word for turn surrounds the square number

parts.note: a go is a turn in a game
nine is a square number, three times three
P is the abbreviation for parking on road signs

explanation.surface: A driver performs a three-point turn, reversing to slot into a parking bay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'square' means a square number, here nine. 'around' sets the turn word round it, 'in reverse' reads that backwards, and 'to get in' adds the parking letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An opening is a gap or space, such as a vacancy or a hole in a wall.

clue.text: Seafood ring eaten by upcoming model

indicators.note: eaten by means the ring word goes inside the other word
upcoming in a down clue means the word is read from the bottom up

parts.note: to pose is to model, as for an artist
to ring someone is to call them on the phone

explanation.surface: A shellfish dish with a ring of something is devoured by a rising fashion model.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ring' means phone, not a circle; 'upcoming' reads the model word upwards, as fits a down clue, and 'eaten by' puts the phone word inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An escallop is another spelling of scallop, a bivalve shellfish eaten as food.

clue.text: Trio after father of Frederick North, former PM

indicators.note: trio says only three letters of the name are kept, dropping its tail
after says we keep what follows the father abbreviation at the start of the name

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest's title

explanation.surface: Appears to ask about the father of Lord Frederick North, the 18th-century prime minister.
explanation.walkthrough: Lord North really was a PM, which makes the surface convincing; 'after' takes what follows the priest's title at the start of the name and 'Trio' keeps three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Anthony Eden was British Prime Minister from 1955 to 1957, so a past holder of the office.

clue.text: A part of speech written in bizarre flyer

indicators.note: written in means these letters are set inside the other word

parts.note: bizarre means weird
a verb is one of the grammatical parts of speech

explanation.surface: A grammar term appears in an odd leaflet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flyer' looks like a printed handbill; here it is a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The weaver bird is an African and Asian songbird that weaves elaborate nests, so a flying creature.

clue.text: Heavy accent

definitions.meaning: the backward-sloping diacritic mark over a vowel, as in French

explanation.surface: A thick or strong way of speaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Grave means serious or weighty, and it also names the diacritic mark used in French over letters like e.

clue.text: On the brink of getting paid to promote centre

indicators.note: in a down clue, promoting moves the central letter of the word up to the top

parts.note: earning means receiving pay for work

explanation.surface: Someone close to a pay rise that would move them up to head office.
explanation.walkthrough: EARNING has N as its middle letter; moving it to the front gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Nearing means approaching or close to, much like being on the verge of something.

clue.text: Soup I rave about covering wooden dish

indicators.note: covering means the rearranged letters wrap round the wood
about signals that these words are rearranged

parts.note: teak is a hardwood, so something wooden suggests teak

explanation.surface: A diner raves about soup served in a wooden bowl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wooden dish' reads as a bowl, but the dish is the definition alone; 'about' jumbles the first three words and 'covering' wraps them round the timber.
explanation.definitionFit: Steak au poivre is a French dish of beef coated in crushed peppercorns.

clue.text: Well-timed acts do this to make great sketches

definitions.text: do this to make great sketches
definitions.meaning: an expert artist's pencil marks: a master's strokes

explanation.surface: Good timing in comedy turns makes for brilliant sketches.
explanation.definitionFit: A brilliantly judged move is called a coup of genius; a skilled artist's lines are literally expert marks of the pen.

clue.text: Foodstuff's temperature affected cereal

parts.note: T is the scientific abbreviation for temperature

indicators.note: affected means altered, so the letters of cereal are rearranged

explanation.surface: Breakfast cereal goes off when stored too warm.
explanation.definitionFit: Treacle is a syrup made in sugar refining, used in puddings and baking, so an edible product.

clue.text: Article by the French president showing no love for state

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
la is French for the (feminine)

indicators.note: showing no means the love letter is removed

parts.note: Barack Obama was US president
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

explanation.surface: A news story about a French head of state who displays no affection for the nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Alabama is one of the fifty United States, in the American South.

clue.text: Spirit of play that is evident in a physical sport

indicators.note: evident in means these letters show up inside the sport's abbreviation

parts.note: RL is rugby league, a rough contact sport
i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A sense of fun shows in a rough contact game.
explanation.definitionFit: Ariel is the airy sprite who serves Prospero in Shakespeare's The Tempest.

clue.text: Daughter found shelters left by one down-and-out

parts.note: D is the genealogical abbreviation for daughter

indicators.note: shelters means the word for found surrounds the other letters

parts.note: to found a building is to erect it
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A daughter discovers a homeless person in a shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: A derelict is a vagrant or tramp, someone with no home or means.

clue.text: About to cut crime after acquiring ace gossip

parts.note: c is short for circa, Latin for about
to hew is to cut with an axe

indicators.note: after acquiring means the crime word takes in the ace letter

parts.note: theft is a crime
A is the abbreviation for ace in cards

explanation.surface: A tale of a knife attack and robbery involving a flying ace.
explanation.definitionFit: To chew the fat is an informal idiom meaning to chat or have a long natter.

clue.text: Touring Bologna, he admits quietly he wouldn't want to be here

definitions.text: he wouldn't want to be here

indicators.note: admits means the quiet letter is let inside
touring suggests moving around, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: p is piano, the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: A tourist in an Italian city mutters that he would rather be elsewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on 'here' meaning the English crossword's home.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who fears or dislikes England and the English would hardly want to be in the country.

clue.text: Lab assistant regularly sampled king cobra

indicators.note: regularly sampled means taking every other letter of these words

explanation.surface: A laboratory worker takes samples from a huge venomous snake.
explanation.definitionFit: Igor is the stock hunchbacked helper of the mad scientist in Frankenstein films.

clue.text: Arachnid's house with new bottom

indicators.note: bottom in a down clue says this letter goes at the foot

parts.note: Scorpio is one of the twelve astrological houses or signs

explanation.surface: A spider's home gets a new base.
explanation.definitionFit: A scorpion is an eight-legged arachnid with a venomous sting in its tail.

clue.text: Leave something for an actor to take on

definitions.text: something for an actor to take on

explanation.surface: An actor is given time off before a new role.
explanation.definitionFit: To part is to separate or go away; it is also a role an actor plays.

clue.text: Update information about novel

parts.note: re means about or concerning
novel means new, original, fresh

explanation.surface: News on a forthcoming book.
explanation.definitionFit: To refresh a web page or display is to reload it with the latest data.

clue.text: Leader of divers propels back boat showing skill with arm

indicators.note: back means the preceding letters are read backwards
leader of means the first letter of divers

parts.note: rows means propels a boat with oars
a craft is a vessel or boat

explanation.surface: The head diver rows the boat backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: D plus ROWS reads backwards as SWORD; 'arm' means weapon, not limb.
explanation.definitionFit: Swordcraft is expertise in fencing or handling a blade, a weapon being an arm.

clue.text: Fully welcoming thin jagged structure containing galleries

indicators.note: welcoming means taking in the jumbled letters

parts.note: all means fully, as in all alone

indicators.note: jagged means rough and broken, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A jagged building with long gallery rooms open to visitors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'galleries' suggests art; here they are tunnels. 'jagged' jumbles the word thin and 'welcoming' takes it inside the word for fully.
explanation.definitionFit: Ant colonies dig mounds riddled with tunnels and chambers, which can be called galleries.

clue.text: Where you'd find step provided for passage

definitions.meaning: on a staircase: a step is part of a flight of stairs
supplied to passengers during an air journey, as with meals

explanation.surface: Steps put in for a corridor.
explanation.definitionFit: A step sits within a set of stairs; in-flight services are provided to travellers during air travel.

clue.text: Prisoner inside is to make representations

indicators.note: inside means the prisoner word sits within the other letters

parts.note: con is short for convict, a prisoner

explanation.surface: A prisoner inside makes formal complaints.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' here is placement, not prison slang.
explanation.definitionFit: Icons are images or symbols standing for something, as on a screen or in religious art.

clue.text: Mathematician's term outsiders avoided in speech

indicators.note: outsiders avoided means the first and last letters are dropped

parts.note: an oration is a formal speech

explanation.surface: A mathematician's jargon is kept out of a public talk.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratio is the mathematical relation of one quantity to another, a staple of maths vocabulary.

clue.text: Mass caterer's ingredient to go off quickly

indicators.note: ingredient signals the letters are found inside the words mass caterer's

explanation.surface: Something in a large-scale cook's recipe spoils fast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go off' suggests food spoiling; it means leave.
explanation.definitionFit: Scat is an exclamation or verb telling someone to leave at once, like shoo.

clue.text: Quickly run through king, escape back round old wharf finally

parts.note: R is Rex, Latin for king

indicators.note: round means the reversed word goes about the old letter
back means the escape word is read backwards

parts.note: to flee is to escape

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of wharf

explanation.surface: A king flees back around an old quayside.
explanation.walkthrough: FLEE backwards is EELF, with O inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To reel off is to recite or list rapidly and fluently, without pausing.

clue.text: Prompt to devour one's home cooking

indicators.note: to devour means the prompt word swallows the other letters

parts.note: a cue is a prompt, as given to an actor
one's is I'S, with I for one
in means at home

explanation.surface: An urge to eat one's own home-made food.
explanation.definitionFit: Cuisine is a style of cooking, such as French or Italian food preparation.

clue.text: With apparent reluctance, boozy late night is last in February

indicators.note: boozy suggests drunkenness, so the letters stagger into a new order
last in means the final letter of February

explanation.surface: Seems unwilling: a drunken late evening is the final one in February.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something hesitatingly means holding back or wavering, showing reluctance.
